scope: Uniform orientation; rotation axis uniform on sphere, speed 2–12 rad/s; CG height 6–20 m; vertical speed −4 to +5 m/s; horizontal velocity 5 m/s; 400 kg full tank; ten nozzles following the public grouping with assumed geometry, thrust and 5-degree side cant; clear ground. All generated cases count, including failures. This distribution is not a measured distribution of driving incidents.
criterion: Existing driving success: one second of stable tire support, no hard/body contact; unchanged thresholds.
note: Old ten-port controller from the pre-fan snapshot vs frozen trained controller with fan enabled. This comparison was run after selection; it was not used to retune the candidate.
